notes.title: Game Update, Build 0075
notes.content:
As mentioned before, this update is focused on fixing and addressing issues and improvements, such as car balancing, based on your feedback. Also, to give more meaning to Team Battles, there is one new feature.

[h3]New Feature: Team System[/h3]
Touge Shakai now features a fully-fledged Team System, allowing players to form and join teams once they hit level 50! We've designed this system to bring players together and enhance the competitive experience.

The Team System includes:
[list]
[*]Creating & Managing Teams – Players at level 50 can create their own teams, while leaders can approve or reject applications, as well as transfer ownership
[*]Team Battles Integration – Teams are now officially tracked in 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, and 5v5 battles, with stats recorded for battles between registered teams
[*]Team Decal - Upon joining a team, you will automatically have access to the team decal in the garage
[/list]
Please head to the "Profile" menu to access it. Teams and team battling is an ongoing feature, and we still have plans to expand upon it to make it more interesting. If you have any interesting ideas, please share them with us.

Since this update doesn't have any content drop, here's a little teaser for what we're currently adding to the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/69b8ebecfc745e524da704b060bb4ef9bfc4cbff.png[/img]

Changelog

[*]Added Team System
[*]Major garbage generation optimization (reduces stuttering)
[*]Buffed Gojira, Makushi, NXR, Nishi and Suisei
[*]Updated backend networking stack and changed service to Steam servers - fixes lobby joining unreliability
[*]Added continent region information to lobby listings
[*]Shrunk Myogi by 10%
[*]Allowed penalties for online freeroam mode
[*]New subtle clearcoat and paint flake effect to car paint
[*]Added LODs optimization for foliage on Sadamine

notes.title: Game Update, Build 0068
notes.content:
In this update, we bring to you a brand new feature, which in a sense is somewhat of an entire game by itself: FPV Drones! As well as the longest track to grace Touge Shakai.

[h3]New Feature: FPV Drone[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/1de2a99f3f55c23b9c77778c7852c4043a913a69.png[/img]
Touge Shakai now features an FPV drone which you can fly in game! The simulation was written from scratch after months of research. However, as we're not actual FPV drone pilots, please reach out to us to give feedback if you're a real pilot and would like to see it be even more realistic! We would love for the FPV drone community to join us, as we think they're a great fit for chasing cars attacking the Touge.

The drone is quite fully featured, and includes 3 flight modes:
[list]
[*] Acro (Full manual)
[*] Angle
[*] Altitude Hold
[/list]

As most FPV pilots would say, although it is the toughest, we recommend Acro mode if you can handle it, as it allows the most agile movements to do some moves required to keep up with the fast cars! Note that because the drone is a high performance drone that can hit over 180km/h to keep up with the cars, it is practically impossible to fly with a keyboard, hence only gamepads and joysticks are supported.

The drone is accessible in 2 ways: while watching a saved replay (accessed from the replay menu), or in an online free roam lobby (spectator option in pause menu). We hope that you have as much fun flying, as you do driving in TS!

[h3]New Track: Sadamine[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/711e32df33b9f7a1e6d46c87caba26c2a38e5eaf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/dec4f0cccc3d649147e9304b0aa1641bf87da08d.png[/img]
We're happy to finally bring you one of our favourite, as well as longest touge course. We feel that Sadamine is a beautiful location, as well as an awesome layout. Enjoy the challenge of this high speed yet technical course, now both on the ground and in the air!

[h3]Other Changes and about the next update[/h3]
We now have a new improved driving HUD (thanks AYLehis!), with more future designs incoming, which you will be able to unlock by playing the game. We will also bring back the old design as an option, if you prefer it! For the next update, we'll be focusing on looking back on the game, such as car balancing, and fixing long standing issues, instead of developing new features that take a long time.

Changelog

[*] Added some anti-cheat measures
[*] Fixed some street lamps not working correctly in some tracks

Firstly, apologies for the duration this update took, but it's finally here! In this update, we now have Team Battles, a new car, and a new track!

[h3]New Game Mode: Team Battles[/h3]
You can now join up with your friends and battle as a Team! Team Battles support 2v2 up to 5v5 battles. For now, it is a very basic implementation, and will be expanded upon in the near future to include more different rules of battling, such as concurrent uphill and downhill battles, and allowing players to vote on the lineup to allow more strategies.

notes.title: Game Update, Build 0048
notes.content:
[h3]It's time for [b]VR[/b]![/h3]

In our opinion, all cockpit based games should support VR, as they're the best ways to immerse players in the experience. Now, we're proud to say that Touge Shakai supports [b]Virtual Reality[/b]! If you have a headset that works with SteamVR, TS should work with it. We also believe that TS is one of the most detailed racing games in terms of interior animations, and we're really proud of it. Now, they can be experienced as intended!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/45a0b026f46af36ab7a84ec16900d941c6ac0d44.jpg[/img]
In our implementation, all of the regular user interface has been adapted to work within the VR environment, and the menu experiences should be familiar. During scenes that are unsuitable for VR, such as camera panning or third person cameras, the game will render these scenes on a "virtual monitor" to prevent motion sickness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/189a03c0e2c23d8e0a7395e1f19e310fd9d35517.jpg[/img]
Just a couple of things to take note of:
[list]
[*][b]Please bind the "Reset VR Position" control within settings before firing up VR[/b]
[*]If you have SteamVR installed, enter the game normally and an option to "Activate VR" should be on the main menu
[*]There is a setting to lock the camera to the horizon under "Camera" settings
[*]VR mode is still slightly experimental and there might be some things we have to fix
[/list]

[h3]New Track: Myogi[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/2931ecd8b32ef10c78b948a72363d7430f251b05.png[/img]
Another great track from the past has been made for TS, and... it's Myogi! A unique but unusual aspect of this location is that for parts of the course, the sides of the road are flanked by wide and low pavements. It's up to you to exploit them to achieve the best racing line!

[h3]Changes, Improvements and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a crapton more rims to unlock (You now unlock a new rim every 2 levels!)
[*]Added more decals provided by kickstarter backers
[*]Optimized mirror rendering
[*]Optimized ghost car rendering
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update, Build 0040
notes.content:
[h3]Rain is here![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/65b47eda95b2fb65a66e833e23103e7db6da036b.png[/img]
In the last announcement about the system being complete, the puddles were randomly placed by the system. Feedback from our testers was that there were many puddles where it made no sense, which made the puddles more of a hindrance than adding to the overall fun. Hence, we've decided to rewrite the system, and now the puddles are hand placed, which was a much more laborious task than we had anticipated. We hope that you guys will now have fun challenging the touge in the wet!

[h3]New Track: Tsuchisaka[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/1593dd7a8e10eab0776ed77444d58f8564089516.png[/img]
It's finally time for a new track, and we're happy to announce that Tsuchisaka will now join the roster as one of the custom made maps for TS. In our previous game, Tsuchisaka was one of our favourite tracks, with a great layout, big elevation changes, and slow and high speed sections. We're really excited for it to make a comeback, and believe that it will quickly grow to be one of your favourite tracks here too!

[h3]Walltap Penalty System[/h3]
In the top level of players, a driving style has emerged, whereby to drift the rear of the car into the guardrails to gain time. The penalty system has been updated specifically to detect this exploit, and should generally not affect the penalties of other forms of collision. Gentle wall taps should still not be penalized. Thereby, along with the new track and rain weather, we've decided that it would be a good time to reset the leaderboards. We hope to see a cleaner driving style at the top of the leaderboards soon!

[h3]Changes, Improvements and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added AMD FSR3 Upscaler (upscaler only, not frame gen)
[*] Attempted fix at "Connecting to server failed" issue. If this issue still occurs to you outside of server maintanence periods, please ping me!
[*] Made multiplayer lobby creation remember last setting
[*] Fixed game crashing when player level exceeds 404 (<- lol)
[*] Made opponent disappear from minimap when their headlights are off during night time
[*] Fixed Futatabi missing colliders
[*] Fixed Okawa missing colliders
[*] Added better error handling to ghost loading
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update: Rain!
notes.content:
Hi guys! Sorry for staying silent for so long. Since it's the end of 2023, We thought it'll be important to give you guys an update!

Firstly, I would like to give an update about my mother. I'm happy to say that she has been recently discharged from the hospital! However, she has not fully recovered, and we need to take care of her at home. Hence, it has actually been taking up more of my time and energy, but fortunately things are looking good. With the less time I've left remaining for TS, I've chosen to spend as much of that time as possible on development, hence the lack of interaction on the Discord server recently. I sincerely apologize for that.

However, on a more positive note: Rain is almost complete! And I'm pretty proud of our implementation of it. Other than just a graphical effect, it also affects the physics. Other than the wet roads being more slippery, there are also physical puddles that the tyres will react to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/2cba924f360a0319984c658e82dbb7b65b6797fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/273079523fe20b8e2159930d29db1585cfa628ae.png[/img]

[img]https://touge-shakai.com/media/makushi.gif[/img]

We've also been working on adding a new custom-made track specifically for TS, which we're currently not ready to show just yet. In the next update, which should be ready in the coming weeks, these are the major new content you can look forward to! In the meantime, check out these teasers and wishing you guys a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Game Update, Build 0028
notes.content:
While the Unity debacle was happening in the previous month, we decided to hold back on developing major new features for the game. In the meantime, we have spent some time researching on alternative game engines, in addition to polishing and fixing some long standing issues within the game. After the most recent announcement by Unity, we've decided to continue to stick with this game engine and development of TS should continue as planned

[h3]New Car: Makushi[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/4320e10e33431d1a2e3e7a116735494712895bab.png[/img]
A well balanced car that looks as good as it drives. We think that its greatest aspect is how well it handles, give it a try!

[h3]New Automatic Save Backup System[/h3]
We have received reports of save files getting corrupted and players losing all their progress, and we understand how frustrating this can be! As such, in this new build of the game, the latest 10 save files will be kept. When loading, the game will search for the newest file, and if it is corrupted, the game will automatically attempt to load the older save files. Hopefully, this will prevent total loss of game progress and only rollback some progress in the event of a file corruption

[h3]Collision Sounds[/h3]
One of the most requested additions is for collisions to have a little more oomph. We've now added collision sounds, and we think they sound pretty good and add a decent amount of immersion to the game

[h3]Rendering Optimizations[/h3]
Another long standing complaint is that the game runs poorer than expected. We've worked on optimizing much of the rendering pipeline of the game: as such, it should now yield a much higher framerate. However, this is not the end of our optimisation process! We are still in the midst of making more tweaks and adjustments to further boost the performance of the game. Our work will also lay the groundwork for more graphically demanding features such as rain, and VR. Stay tune for more updates in the coming (month)!

[h3]Other Changes and Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed reflection settings tied to user, now device specific
- Fixed interior lighting materials of some cars
- Slightly optimized car file sizes and loading
- Attempted fix for odometer NaN bug
- Improved various materials across some cars

notes.title: Game Update, Build 0024

[h3]New Car: VT9[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/13257f677b74f537b08c7ce8b9a45008772e79f1.png[/img]
A new front wheel drive car with a high reving engine, with slightly more power than the Mizuka.

[h3]New Game Mode: Tofu Delivery[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125942/9ffa510d8a0d9e355261f5b587e4e91bc8aa5f78.png[/img]
Confident in driving fast? How about driving smoothly? Challenge yourself in the new tofu delivery game mode!
The name of the game is smooth driving. Each time you jerk your car, the tofu will take damage, and the goal is to deliver the tofu in the best shape possible, while speed is the secondary objective.
A dedicated leaderboard has been introduced for this game mode.


[h3]Changes, Improvements and Fixes[/h3]
- [b]New car parts[/b] for: NXR, Kosei and Seichi
- [b]Basic car temperature simulation[/b]: Cars will idle at higher rpm when the engine is cold, car performance is not affected.
- [b]First person camera settings[/b]: Added adjustable first person and hood camera per car, accessible from the pause menu in game. 
- [b]Leveling[/b]: The max XP cap per level has now been reduced to 50000 xp
- [b]Car balance changes[/b]: The NXR, Kosei and S80 has been buffed to be more in line with the other cars
- Restructured main menu options
- Partially optimised car wheel blur and light calculations
- Possible fix for distance calculations causing XP and money gained to be 0

notes.title: About Early Access Phase and Development Cycle
notes.content:
It has come to our attention that there some concerns with the state of the game right now, so we'll like to address them. Although we have launched the game in Early Access, it has been made known to us that we have not communicated clearly how the development of the game is going to progress.

Being a new start up and our first time developing a full blown game, it's difficult to confidently lay out an entire development road map, but we'll like to share how we plan on working and expanding the game.

Right now, we are fully aware that the game is still far from being completed, and is lacking in content and features for it's asking price. However, we plan to include many more cars and tracks into the game in the coming months.

We plan to have a "Major Update" about every month, whereby we add new content and features, such as cars, tracks, and gameplay features. After each "Major Update", a few smaller patches and hot-fixes will follow to fix and improve upon these new features that we have just added. For some of the features that will be coming to the game, please check out the Early Access section on the store page.

If you're interested in Touge Shakai, but are on the fence about jumping aboard, please continue to watch the development and updates we bring in the subsequent months! In the meantime, here is a sneak peek of the new car that we are bringing in the next content update: The [b]NXR[/b]

notes.title: Touge Shakai Early Access Release
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kHuylgx.png[/img]
It's finally time for Touge Shakai to go public!
The journey has been long, but it's only just the beginning.

Available in the early access, are 5 cars and 2.5 tracks (1 of which is 50% complete)

Game modes include Time Attack (local and online ghosts) with functional leaderboards,
and Online Free Roam, where you can hang out or have impromptu races with others.

Other features include a garage where you can customize your cars, such as their paint, fully fledged livery editor, body kits and wheels.

The game also supports most steering wheels with force feedback on the market from large brands (Logitech, Thrustmaster, Fanatec, etc). We'll be looking to add support for more brands in the future.

We'll continue to update the game with more content and features in the upcoming months, please stay tuned to our [url=https://discord.gg/bmvTBBtmWD]Discord[/url] and Steam page for further developments.

Thank you all for the support, and we hope to see you on the Touge!



Leaderboards are available on the [url=https://www.touge-shakai.com/leaderboard/]official Touge Shakai website[/url].
